title: Pretty Color
text: Pretty Color. The color is spot on. It looks beautiful. Makes my candle holders look more expensive than they are. If you are looking for a powder blue this is your color, buy these. I just didn't like the shipping cost. They are not prime and I pay the full yearly fee for prime.

product_metadata.title: D'light Online Elegant Taper Premium Quality Candles, Hand-Dipped, Dripless and Smokeles - Set of 12 Individually Wrapped (12 Inch, Sea Breeze Green)
features: CLEAN BURNING: These candles are hand-dipped, dripless and smokeless. Create a warm glow in every space.
LONG-LASTING: Enjoy 6-8 hours of burn time depending on color and size. Candles are for everyday use and special occasions.
SIZE & MAKE: Set of 12. These taper candles are 7/8 inches in diameter with a self-fitted end. Will fit in most standard candle holders. Made in the USA.
VERSATILE DECOR: These candles are ideal for weddings, religious events, sweet sixteens, restaurants, and home decor.
FRAGRANCE-FREE. A great choice for people who suffer from allergies or sensitivities to scents and perfumes.
description: Elegant and simple, these hand-dipped taper candles are perfect for parties and centerpieces. Their soft glow adds a warm ambiance to every occasion. Our taper candles are long-lasting with a burn time between 6 to 8 hours. Each candle is unscented. They are great for both ritual and decorative use. Available in a variety of 31 vibrant colors, you can mix and match candles or buy a set to match your design needs. These premium taper candles are also dripless and clean burning. They fit perfectly in most standard holders (sold separately). Our candles are made with quality and your satisfaction guaranteed. We offer classic functional and decorative purposes. Made in the USA.
